% Shared notation (owned by the editor; writers do not edit this file).
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\C}{\mathbb{C}}
\newcommand{\Z}{\mathbb{Z}}
\newcommand{\T}{\mathbb{T}}
\newcommand{\Ach}{\mathcal{Q}}            % action chamber
\newcommand{\Aset}{\mathcal{A}}           % compact set of semi-major axes
\newcommand{\Lset}{\mathcal{L}}           % image of \Aset in actions
\newcommand{\Bst}{B_\star}                % star threshold
\newcommand{\Bcross}{B_{\mathrm{cross}}}  % pair threshold
\newcommand{\dstar}{d_\star}
\newcommand{\dpair}{d_{\mathrm{pair}}}
\newcommand{\Aosc}{A_{\mathrm{osc}}}
\newcommand{\Ael}{A_{\mathrm{el}}}
\newcommand{\osc}{\mathrm{osc}}
\newcommand{\ev}{\mathbf{e}}              % eccentricity vector
\newcommand{\abs}[1]{\lvert #1\rvert}
\newcommand{\norm}[1]{\lVert #1\rVert}
\newcommand{\nrm}[1]{\lVert #1\rVert_\infty}
\newcommand{\nf}[2]{#1/#2}
\newcommand{\Dfn}{D}                      % D(u) = 1 - sqrt(1-u^2)
\newcommand{\aE}{\mathfrak{a}_n}          % Nekhoroshev time exponent 2/(6n^2-3n+14)
\newcommand{\bE}{\mathfrak{b}_n}          % Nekhoroshev drift exponent 3/(6n^2-3n+14)
